scratchpad: The firm is facing a potential loss of 1000 in profit. Option 1 cancels this loss in exchange for 0 tokens (which have no value). Option 2 results in the loss of 1000 profit. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders, I must choose the option that avoids the financial loss.

The firm is faced with a choice: Option 1 results in a loss of 1000 profit and keeping useless tokens. Option 2 cancels the loss of 1000 profit and requires giving up 0 tokens. Option 2 is the only rational choice to act in the best interests of Firm B and its shareholders.
